name: Intercom
shortInfo: Intercom is an AI-first customer service platform.
brief: Intercom is an AI-first customer service platform that provides a customer experience across automation and human support.
about:
The Intercom Reverse ETL connector enables streaming data from a user determined warehouse to the Intercom platform in an automated manner.

Check more about Intercom api documentation [here](https://developers.intercom.com/docs/references/introduction/).
availableSync:
[Articles](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/intercom/syncs/articles.html)

This sync can be used to load articles from a user specified data warehouse to the Intercom platform.

[Companies](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/intercom/syncs/companies.html)

This sync can be used to load companies' details from a user specified data warehouse to the Intercom platform.

[Contacts](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/intercom/syncs/contacts.html)

This sync can be used to load contact details from a user specified data warehouse to the Intercom platform.
